access.owner: An owner has full access: the role matrix is not consulted.
access.default: No role assigned: the default member permissions apply.

userPanel.unconfirmedHint: Confirm it here when the link never reached them.
userPanel.noAccessHint: This account reaches nothing until someone invites it to a project.
userPanel.deleteHint: Issues and comments stay, with the author unassigned.
userPanel.deleteConfirmWithProjects: {count, plural, one {Delete account and project} other {Delete account and projects}}
userPanel.deleteMessage: {name} loses access to this instance. Issues and comments they wrote stay, with the author unassigned. This cannot be undone.
userPanel.soleOwnerTitle: {count, plural, one {Only owner of a project} other {Only owner of # projects}}
userPanel.soleOwnerHint: {count, plural, one {Once the account is gone, nobody can manage it.} other {Once the account is gone, nobody can manage them.}}
userPanel.deleteWithProjects: {count, plural, one {Delete the project with the account} other {Delete the projects with the account}}
userPanel.deleteWithProjectsOff: Or cancel and add a second owner first.

projectPanel.noMembersHint: Nobody can reach this project until someone is invited to it.

general.mcpEnabledHint: A new project is reachable over MCP as soon as it is created.

authentication.registrationHint: Who may create an account on this instance.

open.label: Open
open.description: Anyone who reaches the sign-up page can create an account.

invite.label: Invite only
invite.description: An account can only be created through an invite link.

closed.label: Closed
closed.description: No new accounts. Existing ones keep signing in.

authentication.signInHint: Options that need outbound mail. They stay off until a provider is configured.
authentication.needsProvider: Set up the Email provider under Integrations first.
authentication.requireVerificationHint: A new account must confirm its address before it can sign in.
authentication.magicLinkHint: Offer signing in with a link sent by email, alongside the password.

storage.fileSizeHint: The largest single file an upload may carry. A bigger file is refused before it is stored.
storage.attachmentHint: Applies to issue attachments, files pasted into a description, and attachments added by agents.
storage.avatarHint: The profile picture people upload for their account.
storage.mimeTypesHint: One content type per line. Leave empty to accept any file.
storage.mimeTypesNote: A line is a full type (application/pdf) or a wildcard (image/*). Files already stored are kept whatever the list says.
storage.quotaHint: Total attachment storage one project may use. 0 means no limit.
storage.quotaNote: Once a project reaches the quota, new uploads are refused until someone deletes attachments.

telegram.botConfigured: People connect their Telegram account by opening a chat with this bot from their profile.
telegram.botMissing: Create a bot with @BotFather in Telegram and paste its token here.
telegram.botTokenHint: The token is verified with Telegram when you save, so a wrong one is refused here rather than failing silently later.
telegram.resolvedHint: Resolved from the token. This is the bot people will see when connecting.

email.providerHint: Choose one provider. Credentials are stored encrypted.
email.fromHint: Required for Resend. With SMTP it defaults to the username.
email.projectNotificationsHint: Let projects deliver their notifications through this provider instead of configuring one of their own. Each project still chooses whether to use it.

authProvider.googleConfigured: An address without an account gets one; an address that already has a confirmed account signs into it.
authProvider.googleMissing: Add the client ID and secret first.
authProvider.redirectUriHint: Register this on the OAuth client in the Google Cloud console. Google refuses the sign-in if it does not match exactly.
